# Cell groundtruth

A matrix with the cell type proportions of the single cell object.

## Usage

``` r
cells_groundtruth
```

## Format

Matrix with samples as rows and cell types as columns

## Examples

``` r
data(cells_groundtruth)
head(cells_groundtruth)
```
